enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing. Sleeping. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Sleep. No movement.

Wake up. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up soap. Lather hands. Wash face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Put milk back. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Stand up. Put bowl and spoon in sink. Wipe mouth with napkin. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Look in mirror. Adjust collar. Pick up bag. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Greet colleagues. Put on gloves. Wash hands. Check patient list. Review patient charts. Enter patient room. Check vital signs. Talk to patient. Administer medication. Take notes. Use computer. Attend meeting. Discuss cases. Wash hands. Remove gloves. Take break. Drink water. Use restroom. Return to work.

Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Select food. Pay for food. Find table. Sit down. Eat food. Drink water. Talk to colleague. Finish eating. Clear tray. Throw away trash. Walk to restroom. Wash hands. Walk back to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Check schedule. Review patient notes. Enter patient room. Examine patient. Discuss treatment. Write prescriptions. Use computer. Attend training. Wash hands. Assist colleague. Take vitals. Update records. Talk to family. Clean equipment. Restock supplies.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Remove shoes.

Enter kitchen. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Cook food. Stir. Turn off stove. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Clear table. Wash dishes.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to couch. Sit down. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Enter password. Open browser. Check email. Browse social media. Type message. Click links. Watch video. Adjust volume. Close laptop. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Checking storm updates and charging devices for possible power outage
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up phone. Open weather app. Check storm updates. Pick up power bank. Plug power bank into wall outlet. Pick up phone charger. Plug phone into power bank. Check battery level. Unplug other devices. Turn off lights. Pick up flashlight. Check batteries. Place flashlight on table. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Scrub hair. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clothes. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk to bedroom. Pick up book. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read pages. Turn page. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Adjust pillow. Lie down. Close eyes.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Dry hands. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.
Lie down in bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep. No movement. Breathe.
